wood: One young woman follow her friends enter forest to gather firewood.
wood-2: She sabi find good wood, and di others dey jealous her.
tree: Dat day, she climb one tree, slip, and her hand hook inside di wood.
left: But her friends leave her there.
left-2: When dem return village, her mama ask where her daughter dey.
left-3: Dem deny say dem see her.
song: Alone for forest, di young woman listen for footsteps.
song-2: Anytime she hear any sound, she sing, hoping say somebody go find her.
hunter-2: Di singing for di lonely forest frighten am, so e run.
hunter-3: But e remember di song and later carry am go village.
rescue-2: Dem gather people, cutlasses and tools, then follow di hunter enter forest.
rescue-3: When di young woman sing again, voices answer her.
rescue-4: Dem cut di wood and free her.
wound-2: For house, her mama watch her suffer and fear say she no go ever recover.
promise: As she no know wetin else to do, she promise say anybody wey heal her daughter fit marry her.
hare-5: At last, her mama allow am try.
hare-6: Hare use remedies from di land around dem treat di wound.
healed: Im work succeed, and di young woman recover.
suitors: Soon men come ask to marry her.
suitors-4: Each one hope say she go choose am.
choice-3: Why she go reject money and high position because of am?
gratitude: But di young woman remember who help her when she dey suffer.
gratitude-4: Hare succeed where others no fit.
lesson: She choose am and honour her mama promise.
lesson-2: Her friends allow jealousy turn dem against her.
lesson-3: Others doubt Hare before dem see wetin e fit do.
end-2: So she marry Hare, choosing di one whose actions matter pass to her.
